thread:
maria-finance: Heads-up — Aurora (acct A-349) flagged a billing discrepancy. Their March 19 invoice shows higher usage but our metering indicates ~1.23M streaming tokens were not recorded between 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z. I think we owe a credit.
sam-sales: Customer escalated to CSM, they want a number and timeline today :pray: 
kai-platform: I dug into edge logs for kr region. We saw repeated 502/504s from edge-proxy-kr-2 and the router's metering ack suppression kicked in. Router didn't emit meter events for those sessions. Sample log:```[2026-03-19T02:12:03Z] edge-proxy-kr-2 ERROR 502 upstream_timeout session=xyz123 routes=streaming
[2026-03-19T02:12:03Z] router-meter-suppression INFO suppressed_ack session=xyz123 reason=upstream_failure```
rachel-billing: Can you run a delta query and give dollar impact? Need an estimate to include on a credit memo.
kai-platform: Running quick query now. SQL: ```-- tokens missed by suppressed acks
SELECT count(*) as missed_tokens, sum(cost_usd) as estimated_credit_usd
FROM metering_events_unacked
WHERE region='kr' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-19T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-19T03:00:00Z';```
Query result (fast sample): `missed_tokens=1234567, estimated_credit_usd=12340.67` (rounded in notes). This is tokens from streaming completions that never landed in the ledger.
alex-ops: Backfill option: we can replay raw gateway events into the metering pipeline and reconcile ledger, but it requires a controlled job (BF-20260319-kr2) and about ~2h of work + verification. Slight risk: duplicates if partial acks already exist.
maria-finance: Given customer pressure and audit trail, I'm leaning toward issuing a manual credit of ~$12.34k and scheduling the backfill as an internal audit to validate.
sre-bot: incident-2026-03-19-kr2 created: https://infra.internal/incidents/2026-03-19-kr2 (severity P2).
rachel-billing: I can approve credits up to $15k without finance director. Please attach the proforma memo and affected invoice lines. I'll generate a credit memo once you confirm the final rounded amount.
kai-platform: Confirming final rounding to $12,341.00 based on full-query reconciliation (ran against full window). Will attach CSV export of missing sessions and signed checksum for ledger matching.
maria-finance: Approved. maria-finance approves manual credit of $12,341.00 to Aurora (A-349). Kai, please create backfill job BF-20260319-kr2 and label as "audit-only" since we've issued manual credit; we want cross-check not customer-facing changes. Also open PR with router fix to stop suppressing metering acks on transient upstream failures.
sam-sales: I'll notify CSM & Aurora now and confirm credit post-GL entry. Message to CSM: "We found a metering suppression bug during the kr region outage on Mar 19. We've issued a $12,341 credit and will run an internal backfill to verify. Expect confirmation within 48 hours." :thumbsup: 
alex-ops: Backfill job scheduled, estimate 2h runtime, will run in a canary first then full. Job id BF-20260319-kr2 created and pinned to runbook RB-kr-metering-001.
rachel-billing: Credit memo drafted and queued. I'll post the memo id and GL posting timestamp here once complete.
maria-finance: Thanks everyone. Please tag me when invoice lines and memo are posted so I can close the loop with accounting.
